# TaskCompendium fixtures

Fixtures preserve source examples and recorded review evidence needed to exercise
conversion and evidence parsing. [review/](review/README.md) contains a provider
response with extended defect evidence. Other files are consumed by the adjacent
tests; their assertions define the relevant source contract.

Keep fixture provenance and original grader semantics when updating examples.
A recorded review is a parsing input and does not certify executable readiness.
See the [test overview](../README.md).
